notes.title: Beta 25-5-2 update
notes.content: [p]Small update with some bigger changes in the wake![/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed numerous bugs related to scoring and UI elements[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed glitches with the new animation system[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented a backend UI overhaul[/p][/*][*][p]Begun redesign of the settings menu[/p][/*][/list][p]Give us feedback and report issues at our discord server![/p][p][url="https://quantonium.net/discord" style="button"]discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: Welcome to early access!
notes.content: [p]Thank you for joining us in The Laser Games! We're excited for players like you to come play our game and give feedback as we continue to shape the game.[/p][p][/p][h3]Community Hub, feedback, and more: our Discord server[/h3][p]If you haven't already, [b]join our discord[/b]! We're looking to start up some exciting community events and challenges, and we have various weekly events such as exclusive developer looks into the game, and playtests with the latest of features to try out. Hop in and say hello![/p][p][/p][p] [url="https://quantonium.net/discord" style="button"]Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Monetization survey[/h3][p][b]We want your feedback![/b] You downloaded the demo version of The Laser Games, but what about the full version? As we continue developing the game, we want you to help support our development, whether it's giving feedback on our discord, or purchasing the game directly, or some other method of contribution.[/p][p][/p][p]We want to set monetization targets right, so you can keep playing and supporting and we can keep making great content. After you've checked out what the demo has to offer so far, we ask that you fill out this anonymous survey with your thoughts: [url="https://forms.gle/93C43NjkzTvvK1QJ9"]https://forms.gle/93C43NjkzTvvK1QJ9[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/93C43NjkzTvvK1QJ9" style="button"]Survey[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Thank you![/h3][p]We hope you enjoy the best* online laser tag, The Laser Games![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45263545/5675a602bf137ddca0a3a9cbce228e0c37fa4b9f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p]
